CommunityApplications.Profile: runelite-web runs RuneLite, the open-source Old School RuneScape client, in a container and streams it to any web browser. Log in with your Jagex Account through the bundled open-source Bolt launcher, keep your RuneLite plugins and settings in appdata, and play from a laptop, tablet or work PC with nothing installed. It's tuned for servers without a GPU. Guides for setup, remote access (Tailscale, Cloudflare Tunnel, reverse proxies), performance and troubleshooting are on the project page. For help, please open a GitHub issue. Not affiliated with Jagex or RuneLite.
